name: mirage
text: v1.0.26 is released: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.26 . It has: the rebuilt API monitor (the engine checks each API that is on every few minutes and the Engine > APIs cards show green / yellow / red / grey from those checks, the usage ledger and the last scan, never from the last scan alone), ParlayAPI live play-by-play on the engine as the default live score (ESPN fallback) and a recorder for tennis frames, The Odds API gap-fill cut to every 3 h with a per-purpose spend log, and the tennis win-probability math (tested, not yet connected to any bet). Still open: tennis live betting and bidding until the first real tennis frames are recorded; the Kalshi screen lag when toggled on (tell me which screen if it persists).
